rene: Heads-up — I'm drafting a short migration guide for Optimize (batching -> new API, KV prefetch patterns, compact quant-profile). Want quick eyes on snippets and links before I open the PR.
kasia: I can review. Please include JS + Python KV prefetch examples and one minimal quant YAML. Also a short 4-step rollout checklist.
rene: Draft snippets below. Keep them tiny and copy-paste ready.

# auth + batch example
```py
# old v1
client = Client(api_key=os.environ['OLD_KEY'])
out = client.generate(model='redwood-opt-3b', prompt=p, batch_size=12)

# new v2
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(token=os.environ['REDWOOD_TOKEN'])
out = c.text.generate(model='redwood-opt-3b', inputs=[p1, p2], max_tokens=200, batch_hint=8)
```

# KV prefetch (JS)
```js
// limit prefetch window to 64 keys
await client.kv.prefetch(keys, {limit: 64});
```

# KV prefetch (Python async)
```py
async def prefetch(keys, limit=64):
    await client.kv.prefetch(keys[:limit])
```

# compact quant profile (YAML)
```yaml
quant_profile:
  model: redwood-opt-3b
  dtype: q4_0
  perf_targets:
    latency_p95_ms: 130
    throughput_rps: 30
  fallback: non_quant_variant
```

# minimal rollout checklist (top of doc)
1) Run local smoke eval on representative prompts
2) Canary 5-10% traffic for 24h
3) Monitor quality delta (answer_exact_match / rouge_l) and latency_p95
4) Auto-fallback to non-quant if quality drops >2 points or latency +20%

kasia: Nice. Suggest adding: "avoid prefetch for ultra-short sequences (<32 tokens)." Also cap prefetch to median_seq_len * 2 where possible.
